resources.string: The bundled payload targets firmware build %1$s only. Running it on any other kernel can crash the device. Regenerate the payload from your exact boot.img + xbl_config.img to add support.
Start Shizuku via wireless debugging on the tablet: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → pair, then start Shizuku from its app and come back.
No KernelSU-family manager found. Install one (KernelSU / SukiSU / ReSukiSU / BakaSU / KowSU) first — ReSukiSU is recommended. Without ksud, the run still grants temporary root only.
No installed manager bundles libksud.so; KernelSU will not be loaded.
For authorized security research on devices you own. Kernel exploitation can crash or reboot the device; root and KernelSU live until the next reboot — rerun GhostLock after every boot.
